personal_repos.name: JIRA-Priority-Icons
personal_repos.description: The goal of this work is to provide user-friendly icons for priorities of tickets in JIRA or any other system. The icons in this repository have been intentionally designed with accessibility in mind and provide more visual clues regarding their meaning.
